mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, title, title_source, title_version, status, generation, version, active_task_id, conversation_event_seq AS event_sequence, COALESCE(last_activity_at, create_time) AS last_activity_at FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT message_id, message_seq AS sequence, role, content AS text, revision, completed, source_message_id, execution_id, task_id, occurred_at FROM sq_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND del_flag = '0' AND (#{before} IS NULL OR message_seq < #{before}) ORDER BY message_seq DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.execution_id, r.source_message_id, r.status, r.version, (r.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelled, r.answer_message_id, r.failure_id FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = r.user_id AND s.scope_id = r.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED', 'PARTIAL', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY r.id

SELECT i.interaction_id FROM sq_interaction i JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = i.user_id AND s.scope_id = i.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation WHERE i.user_id = #{userId} AND s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND i.status = 'OPEN' AND i.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY i.id

SELECT DISTINCT a.artifact_id FROM sq_scope_artifact a JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = a.user_id AND s.scope_id = a.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND a.del_flag = '0' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_message_artifact m WHERE m.user_id = a.user_id AND m.artifact_id = a.artifact_id)
SELECT message_id FROM sq_message WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND role = 'ASSISTANT' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY message_seq DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_message ( message_id, user_id, conversation_id, message_seq, role, content, revision, completed, source_message_id, task_id, occurred_at, creator_id, last_updater_id ) VALUES ( #{messageId}, #{userId}, #{conversationId}, #{sequence}, 'ASSISTANT', #{text}, #{revision}, TRUE, #{sourceMessageId}, #{taskId}, #{now}, #{userId}, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, title, title_source, title_version, status, generation, version, active_task_id, conversation_event_seq AS event_sequence, COALESCE(last_activity_at, create_time) AS last_activity_at FROM sq_conversation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND del_flag = '0' AND (#{beforeTime} IS NULL OR COALESCE(last_activity_at, create_time) < #{beforeTime} OR (COALESCE(last_activity_at, create_time) = #{beforeTime} AND id < #{beforeId})) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_activity_at, create_time) DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.operation_id FROM sq_operation o JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = o.user_id AND s.scope_id = o.scope_id JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND s.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND o.status IN ('UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING') AND o.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY o.id

SELECT r.execution_id, r.source_message_id, r.status, r.version, (r.cancel_requested_at IS NOT NULL) AS cancelled, r.answer_message_id, r.failure_id FROM sq_response_execution r JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = r.user_id AND m.message_id = r.source_message_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.message_seq BETWEEN #{first} AND #{last} AND r.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY r.id

SELECT t.task_id, t.origin_message_id AS source_message_id, t.status, t.version FROM sq_goal_task t JOIN sq_message m ON m.user_id = t.user_id AND m.message_id = t.origin_message_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND m.message_seq BETWEEN #{first} AND #{last} AND t.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY t.id
